title: Agent payments
human_answer_md:
**Agentypical payments** support authorised agent spend and human sponsorship that attaches to the existing agent account — without resetting credentials or forcing a browser checkout for every step.

**Honest status:** the payments directory has a real `evaluating` seed (Stripe API). Not Certified. See [/directory/payments.json](/directory/payments.json).
